metadata.title: The Fate of Binary Stars Hosting Planets upon Interaction with Sgr A* Black hole

notes: No eligible stars. The paper simulates generic binary stars hosting planets and reports aggregate HVS/HVP and S-star outcomes (T:p3-b16; T:p5-b0; T:p6-b8); it does not identify any individual simulated star as a Galactic unbound candidate. The named S-stars are mentioned only as bound comparison objects (T:p2-b2; T:p6-b6), and the introductory HVS references are neither individually identified nor analyzed as targets (T:p1-b8).
